control_failures.control_label: mechanical support of a load during maintenance access

hazard_media: stored potential of an elevated component
facts.site: Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop
facts.title: corrective action following learning team review at HO-9401

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 2 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control LOAD_SUPPORT_FOR_MAINTENANCE: the mechanical support of a load during maintenance access had been bypassed, and the learning team review classified this as an individual or team action.

recommendations: Confirm at the next assurance activity that the mechanical support of a load during maintenance access on HO-9401 and M-9401 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in maintaining lifting appliances, specifically proof testing and periodic inspection of hoists. HO-9401 (workshop hoists and press) is in service for heavy vehicle component removal and pressing. The task proceeded during routine operation while the mechanical support of a load during maintenance access had been bypassed. The gravity energy involved is held as suspended load, and the recorded presentation was fall, collapse, crush.
response.summary: On 3 November 2024 a corrective action on HO-9401 and M-9401 at Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop was reviewed against the material unwanted event control it was raised to restore.
